title: Citation-staleness downgrade for HeuristicVerifier across spec sdk-python sdk-typescript and CLI test
question: Does the reference HeuristicVerifier in both sdk-python and sdk-typescript apply a single-point downgrade to citation_quality when a majority of citations have an accessed date older than 180 days while keeping the score floor at 1 and is the rule documented in specification appendix-a-rubric md and covered by tests?
success_criteria: sdk-python open_outcome verifier py applies the staleness downgrade after computing the base citation_quality score and exports STALE_CITATION_DAYS as a module constant set to 180
sdk-typescript src verifier ts ports the same algorithm including the STALE_CITATION_DAYS constant and the floor-at-1 invariant
specification appendix-a-rubric md documents the staleness downgrade rule under the citation_quality dimension
sdk-python tests test_verifier py has three new tests covering majority-stale downgrade fresh-no-downgrade and floor-at-1

capabilities: sdk-python HeuristicVerifier applies staleness downgrade with floor 1
sdk-typescript HeuristicVerifier ports the same algorithm
three new tests in sdk-python cover the new behavior
